verdict.rationale: The public dor.wa.gov pages give only generic processing-time estimates (about 10 business days online, up to six weeks by mail) and a generic 'Look up a business' link. Nothing shows a founder can check the status of their own filing, application, or case from public pages. The transactional My DOR host redirects every unauthenticated request to login, so any status view sits behind an account rather than on public pages.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
